name: Ranking de Frecuencia de Palabras
description: Analiza frecuencia de palabras ranking distribución.
useCase: Detección de texto IA mediante desviación de la ley de Zipf
mechanism: Calcula trigram frequency distribución and checks compliance with Zipf's law. generado por IA text tends to deviate from natural frequency rankings.
source: Jawahar et al. (2020) - Automatic Detection of Machine Generated Text: A Critical Survey
parameters: Tamaño de ventana: adaptativo, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropía, CV, correlación
strengths:
- Effective for detecting generado por IA text
- Language-agnostic estadístico approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger falsos positivos
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies a través de estilo de escrituras

references.title: Jawahar et al. (2020) - Automatic Detection of Machine Generated Text: A Critical Survey
Gehrmann, S. et al. (2019). GLTR: Statistical Detection and Visualization of Generated Text. ACL Demo.
Solaiman, I. et al. (2019). Release Strategies and the Social Impacts of Language Models. OpenAI Technical Report.
